bridge_functions.name: Push.Status
bridge_functions.description: { permission: granted|denied|ask, token } : whether notifications may be shown, and the phone's Firebase token (empty until Firebase has given one)

bridge_functions.name: Push.RequestPermission
bridge_functions.description: Asks Android's notification permission (Android 13 and later). Answers at once { granted, asked }; the answer to the question is read again with Status.

bridge_functions.name: Push.GetToken
bridge_functions.description: The phone's Firebase token { token }, waiting up to 10 seconds for Firebase to give one

bridge_functions.name: Push.TakeLaunchLink
bridge_functions.description: The page of the notification the person tapped { link }, once: empty when none was tapped

bridge_functions.name: Push.SetChannel
bridge_functions.description: Names the notification channel Android shows in the app's settings: { name, description }. Optional; call it once at start.
